title: Model group
description: What a family of models written as arguments would otherwise copy: a definition with {{parameter}} slots that each member fills, named conditions stated in prose, and shared arguments, arguments that apply to every member whose settings match `when` and that meets every condition in `requires`. Kept in topics/<topic>/groups/<id>.yaml. Members stay in their own files and name the group. Nothing is inherited by default, and the engine never sees a group: the build expands each member's shared arguments into its arguments before flattening.

definition.description: The construction the members share. {{name}} marks where a parameter's setting goes; a member may add text of its own after it.

parameters.description: The ways members differ. A parameter with named values is set to one of them, or to {text: ...} for prose of the member's own, which no `when` matches; a parameter without is a prose slot.

generate.description: Each member also gives a variant, a model of its own, for every other value whose requires it meets.

default.description: A generated parameter's value for a member that sets none.

oneOf.description: The prose this value puts in the definition.

text.description: The prose this value puts in the definition.

label.description: A few words naming the value in a variant's name.

requires.description: Conditions a member must meet to take this value.

meets.description: Conditions (the group's or the topic's) every model at this value meets, with the reason.

conditions.description: Named properties a member may have, stated in prose. A member claims one under `meets`, with its reason.

lean.description: The condition in Lean: a predicate on what the group's lean.binder binds, applied as `<lean> <var>`.
The group's construction in Lean, for its shared arguments and its members' verdicts: a member is the Lean model at a value of `var`.

binder.description: What a statement about every member binds, e.g. `(M : Type) [Monoid M]`.

var.description: The bound variable that a member's lean.param fills.

model.description: The Lean model, with {param} for the variable.

is_model.description: A proof that it is a model, with {param}.

settings.description: The parameter values the Lean construction is at: members and shared arguments at other values are not covered.

meets.description: Conditions of the topic every member meets, each with a proof of its predicate for the model, with {param}.
Conditions of the topic (conditions.yaml) every member meets, with the reason; or, given as {text, requires}, those that the members meeting `requires` meet.

lean.description: The argument's verdicts proved in Lean: each a theorem that every model meeting the argument's conditions (and holding its `given` principles) has the verdict, stated from the topic's lean.argument templates, or for a group's argument over its lean.binder.

ref.description: The certificate, a declaration whose type is the generated statement.

when.description: A conjunction over parameters with named values; a list of values within one means any of them.

requires.description: Conditions every member it applies to meets.
